name: Janis
source: Janis has lived in a madhouse since she was a small child because she suffers from what many people call the worst madness ever—she can't use magic. Between her so-called "magic deficiency disorder" and the bullying she has to endure every day because of it, Janis is ready to give up hope, but her life is about to change...
